concerns.text: FR-001 requires re-computing the 'Frozen Baseline' for ALL datasets using random_seed=42. Task T015a implements this for Seed 42 ONLY. However, T019/T019c generate sensitivity metrics for seeds [123, 456, 789, 101112] but there is NO task to compute the 'Frozen Baseline' (classifier training) for these sensitivity seeds. The spec implies a sensitivity analysis for the baseline (to validate the denominator), but the tasks only generate embeddings for these seeds, not the baseline metrics required to calculate the variance of the denominator.

FR-005 and SC-003 require a one-sample t-test (or Wilcoxon) comparing 'CPU-Conditioned' performance against the fixed 'GPU-Tuned' baseline. Task T035 implements this. However, FR-006 and SC-003 also require FDR correction for multiple comparisons. Task T034 applies FDR ONLY to correlation p-values (T033) and explicitly EXCLUDES the t-test results (T035). The spec's SC-003 groups the t-test and FDR correction under the same success criterion, implying the t-test p-values might also need correction or that the spec's phrasing is ambiguous. There is no task to apply FDR to the t-test results if that is the intended interpretation, or a task to explicitly document why the t-test is excluded from the FDR family if the spec intended it to be included.

FR-004 mandates a 6-hour time limit. Task T048b limits the dataset count for runtime validation if necessary. However, there is no task to enforce this limit during the actual execution of US1/US2/US3 on the full dataset set. T048b is a validation step, not an enforcement mechanism for the main pipeline. If the full set exceeds the limit, the pipeline will fail FR-004 without a task to dynamically subset the data for the primary run (not just the validation run).

Task T060 adds a 'Small Sample Warning' if N < 30. The spec's US-003 Independent Test only requires flagging a shortfall if fewer than 20 datasets are available. This is a stricter threshold than the spec requires, potentially causing unnecessary warnings. While not a missing task, it is a deviation from the spec's explicit requirement that should be aligned.

FR-003 requires computing metadata statistics for ALL structured tabular features. Task T045/T045b explicitly forbid imputation and mandate skipping zero-variance features. If a dataset has ALL features flagged as zero-variance, T045 excludes the dataset. The spec does not explicitly state that datasets with ALL zero-variance features should be excluded, only that the system must handle zero-variance features. There is no task to explicitly document or handle the case where a dataset is excluded due to having NO valid features, which might be a violation of the 'ALL datasets' requirement if the exclusion logic is too aggressive.
